description: Consolidate the four scattered ad-hoc worker/review report guards into one shared hand-rolled fail-closed parse module as the single runtime source of truth.

userStories.title: Add shared report parse module and relax WorkerReport optional fields
userStories.description: As a supervisor maintainer, I need one shared hand-rolled parse module exporting parseWorkerReport and parseReviewReport (fail-closed T | null) plus a WorkerReport type whose gates/notes are optional, so both readers and consumers validate report shapes against a single source of truth instead of duplicated ad-hoc checks.
acceptanceCriteria: A new module under src/supervisor/ (e.g. src/supervisor/report-parse.ts) exports parseWorkerReport and parseReviewReport, each returning the canonical WorkerReport / ReviewReport type or null. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'export function parseWorkerReport' src/supervisor/report-parse.ts && grep -q 'export function parseReviewReport' src/supervisor/report-parse.ts]

Both parse functions are fail-closed and never throw: a report missing or mistyping its required discriminator (outcome+story strings for worker, verdict string for review) yields null; a valid report yields the typed object. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/report-parse.test.ts]

Optional fields are validated only when present and their absence does NOT reject: parseWorkerReport accepts a report with outcome+story but no gates and no notes; parseReviewReport accepts a report with verdict but no findings/artifactOfRecord. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/report-parse.test.ts]

Nested shapes are validated when present: gates.typecheck and gates.tests must be strings; each findings[] entry must have string severity and string text, with optional file (string) and line (number); a malformed nested field is handled per the fail-closed contract. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/report-parse.test.ts]

WorkerReport is the single canonical type with gates and notes made optional at the type level; ReviewReport and ReviewFinding are unchanged; all three types remain exported (re-exported from the new module if needed). [oracle: file-assert grep -Eq 'gates\?:' src/supervisor/worker-report.ts && grep -Eq 'notes\?:' src/supervisor/worker-report.ts]

formatWorkerReportSummary still compiles and produces the same output for a full-literal WorkerReport after gates/notes became optional (guarded access, no behavior change for the full-literal case). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/orchestrator-surface.test.ts]

New unit tests cover: valid full report, valid partial (missing gates -> still parses with outcome+story), missing/mistyped discriminator -> null, and malformed nested field handled per contract, for both parseWorkerReport and parseReviewReport. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/report-parse.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New module: src/supervisor/report-parse.ts. Imports WorkerReport from src/supervisor/worker-report.ts and ReviewReport/ReviewFinding from src/supervisor/review-report.ts. Recommend parse functions accept a raw JSON string (do JSON.parse internally, return null on parse error) so BOTH the string-source consumer (result.ts injected FileReader) and the readFileSync consumers (host.ts) share one contract. Making gates/notes optional forces a guard in formatWorkerReportSummary (worker-report.ts:46) where it accesses report.gates.typecheck/tests under noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Mirror the existing typeof-guard idiom (isObject) already used in result.ts / host.ts; do NOT add zod or a *.schema.json runtime loader (ADR 0038, issue gotcha). outcome/verdict validated as strings only, never tightened to a token enum (CAM_*_STATUS semantics live downstream in result.ts). Do not touch the writer side (subagent-implementer.md / subagent-reviewer.md and their templates/ copies).

userStories.title: Route worker-report readers in host.ts and loop.ts through parseWorkerReport
userStories.description: As a supervisor maintainer, I need makeReadWorkerReport and the loop.ts poll-exit check to validate via the shared parseWorkerReport, so the worker-report reader path no longer re-implements its own inline discriminator check.

The loop.ts poll-exit worker-report check (around lines 1156-1162) validates freshness/shape via the shared parser output rather than an inline typeof report.story/report.outcome check. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'parseWorkerReport' src/supervisor/loop.ts]
The staleness guard is preserved: a report whose story does not match the advisory/expected story id is still rejected as not-fresh. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

The CAM-63 contract test stays green (makeReadWorkerReport accepts a full-shape report and rejects one missing the outcome/story discriminator). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/orchestrator-surface.test.ts]

userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/host.ts (makeReadWorkerReport ~121-145), src/supervisor/loop.ts (poll-exit inline check ~1146-1165). Keep return contract identical (WorkerReport | null) so callers are unchanged. Preserve the advisoryStoryId staleness semantics currently in loop.ts (mismatch -> continue polling).

userStories.title: Route result.ts worker-report sites through parseWorkerReport and delete WorkerReportFallback
userStories.description: As a supervisor maintainer, I need result.ts to consume the canonical parsed WorkerReport and drop its divergent WorkerReportFallback type, so there is one worker-report type and no ad-hoc re-check in the outcome reader.
acceptanceCriteria: The WorkerReportFallback interface is deleted from src/supervisor/result.ts; the worker-report read path returns the canonical WorkerReport | null via parseWorkerReport. [oracle: file-assert grep -Lq 'WorkerReportFallback' src/supervisor/result.ts]

extractRecordedTestsGate reads gates.tests from the canonical parsed WorkerReport and stays fail-closed (returns undefined when gates or gates.tests is absent/malformed). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]
The inline re-check of report.outcome/report.story (around line 509) is removed in favor of the parser's validated result. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'parseWorkerReport' src/supervisor/result.ts]

Partial-salvage behavior is preserved: a report with a valid outcome+story but no gates still resolves the DONE path (absence of gates/notes does not reject the report). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

The red-gate refusal and commit-existence/empty-push gate behavior are unchanged (gateTestsIndicateFailure still fires on a recorded failing gates.tests). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

userStories.notes: File: src/supervisor/result.ts (WorkerReportFallback ~258-265, tryReadWorkerReport ~268-274, extractRecordedTestsGate ~282-287, inline re-check ~509). result.ts reads via the injected FileReader (returns string | null): call parseWorkerReport on the string when non-null. gateTestsIndicateFailure and commitSubjectMatchesStory stay in result.ts (token semantics live here, per issue gotcha). Do not switch to throwing: null == 'no report', preserving the readWorkerOutcome fallback control flow across host.ts/result.ts/loop.ts.
